an5.68:1.1: [sāvatthinidānaṃ] pubbevā’haṃ bhikkhave sambodhā anabhisambuddho bodhisatto’va samāno pañca dhamme bhāvesiṃ pañca dhamme bahulīkāsiṃ.
an5.68:1.8: so kho ahaṃ bhikkhave imesaṃ ussoḷhipañcamānaṃ dhammānaṃ bhāvitattā bahulīkatattā yassa yassa abhiññāsacchikaraṇīyassa dhammassa cittaṃ abhininnāmesiṃ abhiññāsacchikiriyāya,
an5.68:1.9: tatra tatreva sakkhibhabbataṃ pāpuṇiṃ sati sati āyatane.
an5.68:2.1: so sace ākaṅkhiṃ anekavihitaṃ iddhividhaṃ paccanubhaveyyaṃ …pe… yāva brahmalokāpi kāyena vasaṃ vatteyyanti,
an5.68:2.2: tatra tatreva sakkhibhabbataṃ pāpuṇiṃ sati sati āyatane. …pe…
an5.68:3.1: so sace ākaṅkhiṃ …pe… āsavānaṃ khayā …pe… sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja vihareyyanti,
an5.68:3.2: tatra tatreva sakkhibhabbataṃ pāpuṇiṃ sati sati āyatane’ti.
